evals.prompt: [$recovery-codex-history] 给我恢复我的CODEX聊天记录
evals.expected_output: Uses the Codex history recovery workflow, runs or proposes status -> backup -> sync, avoids printing secrets, and explains that recovery only works for local history still present in .codex.

evals.prompt: 我刚换了中转，Codex 左边历史记录空了，帮我恢复
evals.expected_output: Recognizes relay/provider switch as the trigger, uses the upstream GODGOD126/codex-history-sync-tool wrapper, and tells the user to restart Codex Desktop after sync.

evals.prompt: 切换 provider 后以前的 Codex 对话看不到了，先备份再同步
